headline: Bias, prejudice, discrimination · 06:36

items.title: 06:36 · In that tripartite division a stereotype supplies
items.detail: In that tripartite division, a stereotype supplies the categorical belief, prejudice supplies the emotional valence, and discrimination executes differential treatment toward people because of group membership.

items.title: 06:46 · Differential treatment at the interpersonal level includes
items.detail: Differential treatment at the interpersonal level includes verbal exclusion, unequal customer service, biased grading, or refusing to rent an apartment to a prospective tenant.

items.title: 06:56 · Look closely at what bias prejudice and
items.detail: Look closely at what bias, prejudice, and discrimination share in common across Greenwald and Banaji, Allport, and Fiske.

items.title: 07:03 · All three constructs describe psychological and behavioral
items.detail: All three constructs describe psychological and behavioral operations that occur inside or between human actors and can run in any direction between any two social groups.

items.title: 07:14 · Any human being of any phenotype or
items.detail: Any human being of any phenotype or ancestry can hold an evaluative bias, feel an inflexible antipathy, or act with differential treatment toward a member of another group.
